goal: VC-201-097 (P1) claims mastery of: Run cargo-geiger and software-bill-of-materials generation for pinned feature sets, recording first-party exceptions and transitive changes; CI flags new exposure with an auditable review path.. Its own narrative does not claim delivery: PARTIAL: first-party unsafe exceptions are allowed and newly introduced unsafe is flagged for review. Verified by `crates/susi-gawd/src/tests/vc_201_097.rs`: allows_first_party_exceptions, flags_new_unsafe_for_review. Residual: running cargo-geiger and SBOM generation for pinned feature sets, recording transitive changes, and gating new exposure in CI with an auditable review path, are not enumera. Prove or refute it: add a nonzero test named vc_201_097_mastery_* that exercises the capability on its production path, and record exactly which part is missing when it cannot be proven. Coverage is not mastery: this closes only when the capability is verified, and a linked closed task is not evidence. Closing this task records the outcome, not a passing test: write .agents/roadmap-verdicts/<the vector>.json with verdict 'delivered' (and the test or record that proves it) or 'not-delivered' (with what is missing and the task ids that track the follow-up work), then run scripts/check-roadmap-verdict.py <the vector> — which is this task's acceptance. A refutation therefore closes the task and files the work, instead of stalling on a test that cannot pass; the roadmap and the queue both understand the record.
